message.mod-stella-tower.floor_cleared: Floor %s cleared! A bonus chest waits by the exit.
message.mod-stella-tower.milestone: Milestone! Floor %s reached. A chest waits beside you.
item.mod-stella-tower.floor_key.desc: Use it anywhere to go to its floor, or carry it into the tower's portal. It is never spent.
item.mod-stella-tower.void_key.desc: Use it anywhere to return to where you entered the tower.
message.mod-stella-tower.void_key.outsid: The Void Key only works inside the tower.
message.mod-stella-tower.void_key.no_ent: The Void Key does not remember where you came from.
item.mod-stella-tower.wisp.desc: Used on a floor of the tower, lights the way to its portal for 20 minutes
item.mod-stella-tower.wisp.rage: Mobs standing on the lit way are enraged
message.mod-stella-tower.wisp.lit: The wisp lights the way to the portal: %s steps
message.mod-stella-tower.wisp.nowhere: The wisp finds no portal to lead you to here
item.mod-stella-tower.ghost_rune.desc: Set into a chestplate or a weapon at the anvil, for %s emeralds
item.mod-stella-tower.ghosted.chest: Ghost Rune: phase through mobs, slowing foes you pass; evade 30%% of blows
item.mod-stella-tower.ghosted.weapon: Ghost Rune: blows pierce half of armor and pass shields
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.armor: Armor: tower blows /%s a piece, %s%% less from its own element
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon.fire: Heat stacks on hits; the fifth combusts for %s%% of the hit
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon.ice: Hits chill; +%s%% damage to slowed or frozen targets
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon.water: Hits soak for 5 s: +%s%% damage taken from all sources
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon.lightn: Every 4th hit chains to 2 mobs within 4 blocks for %s%%
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon.wind: +%s%% damage to airborne targets; extra knockback
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon.void: Hits shred 2%% of armor each, up to %s%%
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.weapon.holy: Heals %s%% of damage dealt; double against undead
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.armor.fire: Full set: attackers burn 3 s and take %s%% of their hit back
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.armor.ice: Full set: %s%% chance to freeze an attacker for 1 s
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.armor.water: Full set: regenerate %s%% of max health every 10 s
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.armor.lightni: Full set: each hit taken stores a charge (max 5); the next attack deals +%s%% per charge
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.armor.wind: Full set: %s%% chance to dodge a hit
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.armor.holy: Full set: %s%% less damage from undead
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.armor.dark: Full set: attackers get Weakness I for %s s
item.mod-stella-tower.rune.how: Set at an anvil for %s emeralds
message.mod-stella-tower.guardians_rise: The bones sink into the sand. The Tower Guardians rise again.
item.mod-stella-tower.perfect_invisibili: For a minute no mob sees you, the undead included, until you strike a blow.
item.mod-stella-tower.soul_tonic.desc: Heals you in full and grants Regeneration III for 30 seconds.
item.mod-stella-tower.phantom_arrow.desc: A spectral arrow that pierces two bodies after the first.
item.mod-stella-tower.ghost_lantern.desc: Gives full light, and makes the invisible mobs within 16 blocks glow.
item.mod-stella-tower.ectoplasm_charm.de: Carried, it cheats death once; it needs ten minutes to recover.
item.mod-stella-tower.tower_whetstone.de: Carried, it makes the next refine at an anvil unable to fail.
message.mod-stella-tower.merchant.appear: A wandering ghost merchant has come to the floor.
message.mod-stella-tower.merchant.tower_: The ghost merchant sells its goods only in the tower.
message.mod-stella-tower.merchant.short: The ghost merchant wants %s emeralds. You carry %s.
